tools.name: listen_act
tools.description: Turn the Hearing world on or off. "start" begins capturing system audio (or one application) and delivers speech chunks as events; "stop" ends it. Each chunk arrives as an event with a WAV attachment; hand its handle to stt_transcribe when you want the words.

action.description: start = begin listening, stop = end it.

source.description: For start only: overrides the configured source, system audio or one application.

app.description: For start with source=app: process name or PID string from listen_read action=source_list. Defaults to the configured application.

minutes.description: For start only: auto-stop after this many minutes; 0 uses the configured value.

summary.zh: 打开或关掉听觉：开始/停止监听系统声音或某个应用的音频。
summary.en: Turn hearing on or off: start/stop listening to system audio or one application.

tools.name: listen_read
tools.description: Read Hearing information without starting or stopping capture. source_list lists applications with Windows output audio sessions (including inactive sessions, not necessarily playing now), returning names, PIDs and window titles; use a PID string as app in listen_act action=start source=app. status reads listening state, target, counters, settings and last error. recent lists heard speech chunks and WAV attachment handles; hand a handle to stt_transcribe for text.

action.description: source_list = applications with audio sessions; status = hearing status; recent = recent speech chunks.

limit.description: For recent only: how many chunks to list (1-50); default 10.

summary.zh: 查询听觉：音频会话应用列表、监听状态或最近语音块。
summary.en: Read Hearing information: applications with audio sessions, listening status or recent speech chunks.

description.zh: 听到一段语音：正文说明时长与来源，附件是一段 WAV 音频块，可直接交给 stt_transcribe 转写。
description.en: A speech chunk was heard: the text carries duration and source; the attachment is a WAV chunk that can be handed to stt_transcribe.
